title: Autism Red Flags and Developmental Screening Principles
subject: Developmental Milestones
preview: Social communication differences, restricted behaviors and developmental concerns merit a comprehensive assessment.
quickRevision: Social communication differences, restricted behaviors and developmental concerns merit a comprehensive assessment.
Screening identifies children who may need evaluation; a positive screen is not a confirmed autism diagnosis.
Hearing assessment is important when speech or response-to-name concerns arise.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Social communication differences, restricted behaviors and developmental concerns merit a comprehensive assessment.
Not responding to name, reduced joint attention or loss of language may be warning signs but are not diagnostic by themselves.
